subject: Vendor onboarding: Northbound Logistics — intake & PO routing checklist
messages:
From: Jordan Hale <procurement@northbound.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-01-11T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Intro + vendor intake for Northbound Logistics

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. We're ready to move forward with the vendor onboarding so we can accept POs from Redwood and set up electronic payments. To speed things up, attaching our standard vendor packet and bank details. Can you confirm Redwood's preferred PO flow and any specific fields you need on invoices?

Quick answers to things you might ask:
- Tax form: attached (W9).
- EFT: yes, ACH details attached.
- Billing cadence: Net 30.

We'd appreciate a short checklist of items Redwood needs from us and any sample invoice/PO fields so our AP team can align.

Thanks,
Jordan Hale
Procurement Manager
Northbound Logistics
[Attachment: Northbound_W9.pdf (PDF, 145KB)]
[Attachment: Northbound_BankDetails.xlsx (XLSX, 48KB)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Hale <procurement@northbound.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-01-11T12:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Intro + vendor intake for Northbound Logistics

Hi Jordan — great to connect. Welcome aboard. I attached Redwood's vendor intake template to this thread (Redwood_Vendor_Form.xlsx). Below is a concise two-column checklist: what we need from you / what Redwood will provide. Please confirm and return the completed form.

What we need from you:
- Completed vendor intake form (attached).
- Signed W9 and bank details (received).
- Primary AP contact (name, email, phone).
- Remittance email and PO acceptance contact.
- Insurance cert if services exceed $50k annually (let us know if not applicable).
- Any required sub-vendor disclosures or export controls.

What Redwood will provide:
- PO issuance (we use PO numbers on all invoices).
- Standard net-30 payment terms unless otherwise negotiated.
- Finance contact for payment escalations.
- DocuSign link for master services agreement if applicable.

PO routing specifics:
- Please put PO number in the invoice header and on each line item.
- Redwood prefers electronic invoices to accounts@redwood.com and PDF attachments.
- For ACH setup, our finance team will send an authorization form and micro-deposit verification.

Next steps:
1) Jordan: populate the attached form and return with AP contact by EOD Thursday 1/12.
2) Vanessa: I'm copying you to confirm if insurance is required and to own the DocuSign MSA if needed.
3) I'll open a vendor record in our procurement system once we have the completed form.

Thanks — I'll follow up if anything missing.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Commercial Ops
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_Vendor_Form.xlsx (XLSX, 24KB)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Hale <procurement@northbound.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-01-13T10:00:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Intro + vendor intake for Northbound Logistics

Jordan — received, thanks for the quick turnaround and the completed intake. A couple short items before we flip the live vendor switch:

Action items for Northbound (please reply inline to confirm):
- Confirm remittance email for PDF invoices (we will route to accounts@redwood.com unless you prefer accounts@northbound.com).
- Confirm whether you require our MSA or will accept Redwood's standard vendor terms (I can send DocuSign).
- If you want test PO, reply 'yes' and we can issue one for $0.01 to validate routing.

Redwood next steps (owner in parentheses):
- Create vendor record in ProcureFlow and assign vendor ID (Marissa).
- Send ACH authorization form to be returned to finance (Karthik).
- If insurance endorsement required, Vanessa will coordinate with legal/insurance ops.

Estimated timeline: vendor record and PO capability by EOD 1/16 if we receive remittance confirmation and signed ACH form by 1/15.

If all good, I'll send a Drive link with the vendor summary and a DocuSign envelope for the MSA.

Thanks again — excited to get you online.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Commercial Ops
Redwood Inference
